# synology_package (Resource)

Existing installed Synology package and running policy. Import is required and read-only. Version and placement are observed; installation, upgrade, downgrade and relocation are not exposed. Start/stop and protected uninstall require an eligible queue containing only the requested package. Package operations are serialized through readback. Built-ins and custom uninstall wizards remain protected. No custom SPK download or license/signature bypass is performed.

## Adopt existing settings

Use an initialized project from [Check the NAS connection](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/synology/latest/docs#check-the-nas-connection). Add this import block with your resource address and the ID of the existing DSM object.

```terraform
import {
  to = synology_package.application
  id = "ExamplePackage"
}
```

1. Add the resource block with the values DSM currently reports. Use the sample configuration as a starting point.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan`. For one import, expect `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`. If the plan proposes changes, match the differing arguments to DSM and save a new plan.
3. Run `terraform apply adopt.tfplan` once the saved plan contains only the import. The next `terraform plan` should report `No changes`.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "synology_package" "application" {
  package_id          = "ExamplePackage"
  running             = true
  deletion_protection = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `package_id` (String) Installed DSM package identifier. Import is required; this resource never installs or reinstalls software.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Protect package and application data from uninstall by default. Disabling this in a separate reviewed apply permits deletion of an eligible package; package data may be removed by DSM.
- `running` (Boolean) Requested running policy. Omission preserves the stable existing policy. Unsupported or transient states are not reported as stopped.

### Read-Only

- `automatic_updates` (Boolean) Observed automatic-update membership; package update policy has a separate owner.
- `beta` (Boolean) Observed beta-channel installation.
- `can_uninstall` (Boolean) DSM permits package uninstallation.
- `custom_uninstall` (Boolean) Uninstallation requires a custom wizard and is refused by this resource.
- `id` (String) Stable installed-package ID and import identifier.
- `important_updates` (Boolean) Observed important-update membership.
- `name` (String) Observed display name.
- `reconciliation_required` (Boolean) An unfinished or uncertain package mutation is retained. Acknowledged work resumes with read-only polling; unacknowledged updates require explicit reconciliation.
- `silent_upgrade` (Boolean) Observed silent-upgrade behavior.
- `startable` (Boolean) DSM allows start/stop operations.
- `status` (String) Observed DSM status. Configuration readback is not evidence that application data has been restored.
- `version` (String) Observed installed version. Installation and exact-version upgrades are not exposed because the verified quick API does not bind its mutation to a selected version. Package Center separately owns automatic-update policy.
- `volume` (String) Observed installation volume: system or /volumeN. Relocation is not exposed.
